name: Call Board: a turned-in Dungeon Diving daily can be taken again while the week still holds completions
contract: Call Board contracts bank one completion per day of the week begun (CoA.CallboardContracts.DailyCompletions 1). On live Ascension a player who had not done Dungeon Diving for several days could take and turn in the same Call Board quest once per banked day in a row (reported by the project owner, #11083). A level-60 Human turns in Heroic Dungeon Diving (81245); with at least two days of the week begun the quest is takeable again the same day and can be turned in a second time. The weekly quest reset is Thursday 06:00, so on a Thursday only one completion is banked and this case does not apply.

steps.label: Join the world phase the board is spawned in
It is takeable again the same day
Take and complete it a second time
It is in the quest log
Turn it in a second time
The second turn-in pays 1500 Runes of Ascension
